subject: Renewal kickoff — uplift playbook + legal handoff
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@truenorth.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff — uplift playbook + legal handoff

Ethan / TrueNorth team,

Thanks for confirming the renewal timeline earlier today. Per our call, I wanted to kick off the renewal thread and lay out a compact playbook so we can lock calendar slots, surface any procurement/legal constraints, and align on QBR timing. High-level plan below: 

- Objective: 18-month term extension, +25% committed throughput (burst pool + reserved capacity), and SSO + expanded audit log retention.
- Owners: Redwood (Kimberly — AM), Product/Infra (David — technical lead), Customer Success (Marissa — onboarding/staffing), Legal/Commercial (Rishi — internal coord).
- Key dates: proposal & mutual action plan by 2028-06-11; legal redlines week of 2028-06-18; QBR + exec approval week of 2028-06-25.

Immediate asks for you: 
1) Confirm the two-week window the procurement/legal team prefers for redlines (we penciled 6/18-6/22).
2) Share any new internal approvers (names + emails) we should include on future drafts.
3) Preferred QBR week/day and exec attendee list (for a 30–45m readout).

I've attached an initial mutual action plan template (rows: milestone, owner, due) and a draft SLA amendment that sketches the throughput changes and SLOs. If you want, we can convert the MAP to a shared Google Sheet and maintain tasks there.

Suggested next step: 30-minute alignment call this week to confirm owners and lock two candidate QBR slots. I can host Wed 6/6 10:30–11:00 PT or Thu 6/7 14:00–14:30 PT — what works for you?

Thanks,

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: TNH_Renewal_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), SLA_Amendment_draft.pdf (pdf stub)
From: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@truenorth.health>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@truenorth.health>, Procurement Team <procurement@truenorth.health>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 11:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — uplift playbook + legal handoff

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the clear plan. Quick responses below: 

- Procurement/legal redline window: 6/18–6/22 works best for us (we'll aim to have internal comments consolidated by 6/20).
- Approvers to add: Laura Chen (Head of Procurement) <laura.chen@truenorth.health> and George Patel (VP Security) <george.patel@truenorth.health> — I'll introduce George on the redline pass if we need a security exception.
- QBR week: 6/25 is ideal; preferred time is Tue 6/25 14:00–15:00 ET. Execs: our CTO (Anita Rao) will attend for the readout.

We'll take a look at the MAP and SLA draft. For the uplift, can you include a short appendix on expected token-cost delta per 1M extra tokens and an estimate for burst billing? That helps our finance lead model the runway.

We can do the alignment call Thu 6/7 14:00–14:30 PT — that works for Laura and me.

Best,
Ethan
Ethan Liu
Director, Platform Engineering | TrueNorth Health
ethan.liu@truenorth.health | +1 (617) 555-0199

On Mon, Jun 4, 2028 at 09:12 Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Ethan / TrueNorth team,
> 
> Thanks for confirming the renewal timeline earlier today...

Adding a couple of operational notes from Legal/Commercial perspective:

- I'll coordinate an internal redline tracker and share an editable PDF for markups by EOD 6/12 so we can consolidate comments before 6/18. Please send any technical addenda to me directly (I will route to Legal).
- For the SLA amendment: include explicit rollback/fallback language in case performance regressions arise during the first 60 days after uplift. Procurement usually wants a staged acceptance window.
- We should also surface any data residency or logging retention asks from TNH now so we don't chase them later (Laura / Ethan: if there are non-standard retention policies, flag them in the MAP).

Operational ask to internal team: Marissa, can you draft a 1-page onboarding staffing plan (SE + CS touchpoints) for the uplift? David, please outline the expected provisioning lead time for reserved GPUs and burst slots (estimate in business days). I'll own coordinating redline consolidation and routing to our legal counsel.

Rishi Malhotra
